components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when omitted
            on creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, permits creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they share a household).
            Input only; never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and
                last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned customer code formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>',
                where LAST3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the last name
                and NNNN is a global 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: SMI-0007
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Server-assigned stable identifier shared by all owners of the
                same household (same last name and address). Owners that opt in with
                sharesHousehold receive the same value.
              type: string
              example: 3a7bd3e2360a3d29eea436fcfb7e44c735d117c42d1c1835420b6b9942dd4f1b
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets

Full suite is green. Here's what I implemented.

## Summary

The spec: `POST /api/owners` must record `namesakeCount` — the number of existing owners sharing the new owner's `firstName` + `lastName` (case-insensitive) *before* this create — and return it on later reads (the test creates two same-named owners then `GET`s the second and expects `namesakeCount == 1`).

Since the value is a create-time snapshot that must survive to a later `GET`, I persisted it rather than recomputing on read (recomputing would give a different, non-snapshot answer for the *first* owner).

Changes, each in its natural place:

1. **`CountNamesakes.java`** (new) — a single-responsibility OfficeFloor step that counts existing owners with a matching name via `OwnerRepository.findAll()` and stores it on the built owner. Runs after `BuildOwner`/`AssignHouseholdId` and before `SaveOwner`, so `findAll()` sees only the pre-existing owners.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `countNamesakes` step into the pipeline (`assignHousehold → countNamesakes → save`), under the same `transaction` governance as its neighbors.

3. **`Owner.java`** — added a nullable `Integer namesakeCount` (`@Column(name = "namesake_count")`) with getter/setter, following the existing `customerCode`/`householdId` field pattern.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it and MapStruct maps it by name automatically (no mapper change needed — the existing `RespondWithOwner`/`RespondWithOwnerCreated` responders now emit it).

5. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added the nullable `namesake_count` column so JPA `ddl-auto=none` matches the entity. Seed owners leave it null; only created owners get a value.

`AcceptanceTest#coreCountsNamesakes` and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
